proof_summary: Direct finite tables provide Goldbach and Lemoine representations up to the two cutoffs, while above them a positive count supplies a witness giving respectively \(n=(n-q)+q\) or \(n=(n-2q)+2q\). For any bound \(a\), applying the even case to \(n=2(a+4010)\) and using \(2q<n\) makes \(n-q-6>a\), so the guaranteed primes \(n-q-6\) and \(n-q\) form a cousin-prime pair beyond \(a\).
